text: dsh-app-restart 是面向 DSH 桌面客户端的设置界面扩展，在设置中加入应用重启区域和确认按钮。它通过客户端设置槽展示可用状态，并由 Host 提供状态查询与重启请求路由；支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的平台化退出与重新启动流程。用户可查看当前环境是否支持、查看不可用原因，并在确认后请求优雅退出和自动重新打开应用。适合希望从 DSH 设置界面快速重启桌面应用的用户。可选配置 enabled 用于停用功能，dryRun 用于只返回计划；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-app-restart adds a restart section to desktop DSH Settings. It shows availability and, after confirmation, asks the Host to quit and relaunch the app on macOS, Windows, or Linux. Users can restart from Settings and see why it is unavailable. No API key or external service is needed.
想从桌面版 DSH 的设置里直接重启整个应用。
能不能先查看当前环境是否支持重启，再确认执行？
I want a settings button that gracefully quits and relaunches my desktop DSH app.
dsh-app-restart 的功能「设置中重启应用」：设置页先显示重启支持状态，点击按钮后进入确认步骤，再发送重启请求；Host 按系统生成退出并重新打开应用的计划。

dsh-app-restart README · dsh-app-restart：Adds a **Restart application** section to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app Settings, with a guarded button that restarts the whole application — the Electron shell, the hosted Web GUI, and the cordis Host process.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-app-restart README · What it does：The Electron shell offers plugins no restart IPC (`app.relaunch()` is main-process only), so the restart is orchestrated at the OS level from the Host process. No DSH source modifications are needed.

The navigation icon is registered into the shell’s own `settings.section.icon` slot (DSH 0.2.2+), keyed by the same section id — no label markup, stylesheet override, or DOM probing. On older shells that predate that slot the section still works and simply keeps the shell’s fallback gear.

dsh-app-restart README · From GitHub (one command)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/foreee/dsh-app-restart"
```

The Web **Plugins** page can install the same address through its install-by-path/git dialog.

dsh-app-restart README · Manual equivalent：The two steps the plugin manager performs:

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add "file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-app-restart"   # or the GitHub address

dsh-app-restart README · then add "dsh-app-restart" to package.json -> dsh.profile.bundles：```

Restart the desktop app once to load the plugin; the section appears under Settings from then on.

dsh-app-restart README · Routes：| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api/dsh-app-restart/status` | GET | availability facts for the button |
| `api/dsh-app-restart/restart` | POST | perform the restart |

Both sit behind a loopback-only trust fence (loopback socket **and** loopback Host header, same-origin markers enforced). Paired remote devices are deliberately rejected: only the machine's own GUI may restart the app.

dsh-app-restart README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | set `false` to mount nothing |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `POST /restart` answers with the computed plan and spawns nothing — for verification |

dsh-app-restart README · Platform support：| Platform | Quit via | Relaunch via | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| macOS | Quit Apple Event (bundle id, then app name) | `open <bundle>` after the main PID exits | primary target |
| Windows | `taskkill /PID` (graceful WM_CLOSE) | PowerShell `Start-Process` after the PID exits | best effort; if the app cannot be closed gracefully the relauncher still reopens it after the next manual quit |
| Linux | `SIGTERM` | `nohup <exe>` after the PID exits | best effort |

dsh-app-restart README · Platform support：The plugin refuses to run against a development Electron checkout (no `app.asar` beside the executable, or the generic `com.github.Electron` bundle id) — a stray relaunch of the generic Electron binary would not boot DSH anyway.

dsh-app-restart README · Development：The client half (`lib/client.js`) is a hand-written `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle — the same shape tsdown emits for official client plugins — so no build step is required; edit and reinstall.
